name: Kin Guesses Who
purpose: A twenty-questions game where your Kin guesses a real public figure, checking candidates on Wikipedia. After a miss you can type the name to teach it; that name is checked on Wikipedia too.

actions.name: start_round
actions.description: Start a round of Kin Guesses Who: the person thinks of a real public figure and you guess who by asking yes/no questions. Use when they want to play twenty questions or Kin Guesses Who.

actions.name: answer_question
actions.description: Pass the person's answer to your current Kin Guesses Who question or guess: yes, probably, dont_know, probably_not or no. Use right after they answer.

actions.name: give_up
actions.description: End the current Kin Guesses Who round when the person gives up or wants to reveal who it was.

actions.name: teach_public_figure
actions.description: After you missed a Kin Guesses Who round, learn who it was: pass the public figure's name the person tells you.

actions.name: quit
actions.description: Quit Kin Guesses Who: end the current round and close the game. Use when the person says they want to stop or quit the game.
